skill.description: Guide for adding CloudBase AI text generation to WeChat Mini Programs with wx.cloud.extend.AI, billing preflight checks, model readiness checks, streaming callbacks, and custom model onboarding.

content.user_title: Build WeChat Mini Program AI Calls
content.value_statement: WeChat Mini Program AI setup has provider, billing, and streaming differences that are easy to misconfigure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through CloudBase preflight checks and wx.cloud.extend.AI usage.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use wx.cloud.extend.AI for WeChat Mini Programs.
Guides billing eligibility checks for Growth Plan and Token Credits.
Shows how to verify and enable CloudBase AI model groups.
Provides generateText and streamText usage patterns with WeChat callback behavior.
Clarifies provider and model field selection for cloudbase, hunyuan-exp, and custom groups.
Documents custom model onboarding through CloudBase console or CreateAIModel.
limitations: Does not support browser, Node.js backend, or native app AI integrations.
Does not perform image generation in Mini Programs.
Requires valid CloudBase environment access and WeChat base library 3.7.1 or later.
Model availability and pricing must be checked in the target environment.

use_cases.title: Add AI Chat to a Mini Program
use_cases.description: Use the skill to plan CloudBase AI setup and add text generation with the correct WeChat Mini Program API shape.

use_cases.title: Prepare Model Access Before Launch
use_cases.description: Use the preflight guidance to confirm billing eligibility, model group readiness, and enabled model choices before release.

use_cases.title: Connect a Custom Model Group
use_cases.description: Use the custom onboarding flow when a managed CloudBase catalog model does not meet project requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm Basic Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: I am adding AI text generation to a WeChat Mini Program. Check the required CloudBase setup steps before writing code.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Streaming Chat
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add a streaming chat response in a WeChat Mini Program using wx.cloud.extend.AI and callbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Enable a Managed Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through checking whether a CloudBase managed model is enabled, including pricing and readiness considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Onboard a Custom Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to use a third-party or self-hosted model endpoint. Plan the custom CloudBase model group setup and Mini Program integration.

output_examples.input: I want default AI text generation in a WeChat Mini Program.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a setup sequence: confirm environment access, check Growth Plan or Token Credits eligibility, verify model readiness, then add the generateText call.

output_examples.input: My streamText call returns parameter errors.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the Mini Program parameter wrapper difference and reviews callback handling, completion events, and model group readiness.

output_examples.input: I need to use a private model endpoint.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines console or Cloud API onboarding, recommends a custom group name, and keeps API keys out of Mini Program code.

best_practices: Run billing eligibility checks before model group readiness checks.
Use cloudbase or hunyuan-exp as the provider, then place the concrete model ID in the model field.
Verify model availability and pricing before enabling or changing CloudBase AI models.
anti_patterns: Using vendor names as createModel providers.
Skipping billing and model readiness checks before writing business code.
Hardcoding third-party API keys in Mini Program code.

faq.question: Can this skill be used for web apps?
faq.answer: No. It is written for WeChat Mini Programs that use wx.cloud.extend.AI.

faq.question: Does it choose the model provider automatically?
faq.answer: It explains the decision path. You still need environment checks before selecting cloudbase, hunyuan-exp, or a custom group.

faq.question: Does streamText work like the Node SDK?
faq.answer: No. Mini Program streamText requires a data wrapper and supports callbacks such as onText, onEvent, and onFinish.

faq.question: Can it help with custom model endpoints?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes CloudBase custom model groups and keeps endpoint secrets on the CloudBase side.

faq.question: Does it handle image generation?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that image generation is not available through this Mini Program flow.

faq.question: What permissions are needed?
faq.answer: You need access to the target CloudBase environment and permission to query or update AI model settings.
